## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with single-class conformal set [F1] and suggested tumor at all four margins [F11].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% | Near-certain invasive probability |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} (alpha 10%) | Single class at 90% coverage |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% / 100th percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Passes QC; no reliability flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Yes (same top class) | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (74%–84% similarity) [F5] | All nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 3, 7) · ↑ invasive · Strongest positive concept (+1.95), above typical [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 11) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable score (+1.17); failed AI spot check (0/20) [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (-1.31) pushes toward invasive (+0.96) [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.65) matches 95th-percentile shape variation [F9] · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 3, 5, 8) · context · 75% neoplastic nuclei (97th percentile; 226 cells) [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on dataset deletion test (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197), though all 12 regions here score 100% risk.
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable **Frequent mitotic figures** (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu carcinoma (nearest contrast BACH_0046, 67% similarity) mimics stromal invasion on simulated frozen section.
- Crop-boundary tumor cellularity triggers false four-margin involvement calls (430–645 µm per edge) without true surgical ink.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 3, 7**: Confirm true stromal invasion versus in situ carcinoma, and verify scarce tubules in region 3.
2. **Regions 3, 5, 8**: Verify dense tumor cellularity (41–104 cells/region), nuclear size variation (93rd percentile) [F8], and TILs [F10].
3. **Regions 1, 2, 11**: Manually count mitoses (unreliable AI concept) and inspect perimeter margins (430–645 µm involved).
